entity.name: Gean Labs
entity.description: Gean Labs is an African post-quantum infrastructure company. We build Gean, an open-source consensus client for Lean Ethereum, Ethereum's post-quantum consensus redesign. Gean Labs is the first team in Africa contributing a client to Ethereum's core protocol.

projects.name: Gean
projects.description: Gean is an open-source, post-quantum consensus client for Lean Ethereum, written in Go. It replaces BLS signatures with hash-based XMSS signatures and zero-knowledge signature aggregation so Ethereum's validator set can stay secure against quantum attacks, and it implements Lean Ethereum's faster finality and simpler protocol. Gean runs on the multi-client post-quantum devnets alongside the other independent Lean Ethereum clients, strengthening client diversity as Ethereum prepares for its post-quantum transition.
